exposure: five or more previous cesarean sections
Number of previous cesarean sections (1, 2, 3, 4, 5 or more)
outcome: Admissions to the high dependency unit
cohort: 1008 women giving birth by cesarean section who had previously undergone one or more cesarean sections, had a singleton pregnancy, and were not in labor
finding: The risks of placenta previa, placenta accreta, uterine dehiscence or rupture, postpartum hemorrhage, blood transfusion, bladder injury, longer operative time and hospital stay, and more admissions to the high dependency unit increased with increasing numbers of previous cesarean sections.
mod_finding: The study focused on the outcomes of multiple cesarean sections, highlighting the increasing risks associated with each subsequent cesarean delivery.
